justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1 (Achilles) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal replay, with a linear track and long flanking rest epochs.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed from S3 via remfile, pyramidal units selected by cell_type, place fields built from >5 cm/s running, ripple channel chosen by 150-250 Hz power, all correctly aligned.
justification.analysis: Standard Bayesian decoding with a posterior-weighted correlation replay score benchmarked against a per-column position shuffle null (500/event), an appropriate and correctly applied method.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (696 events, 202/29%, 117/17%, 121 forward, 81 reverse, mean |wc| 0.422) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Place fields tile the track, ripple morphology is textbook, and example replays show coherent sweeps; examples are ranked by weighted-correlation strength, which is the effect itself, so no cap applies.
justification.honesty: Nothing is misrepresented and examples are honestly labeled as the strongest cases with the full distribution shown, but no explicit limitations (single session, liberal column-shuffle null) are stated for this clean result.
